title: [3.0-beta1] NSClient "stuck" in Virtual pump mode + missing glucose "dots" in graph
body:
I initially had activated Virtual pump in AAPS for an hour or so before switching to Dash and starting the first pod. After starting up with a live Dash pod, I have exported settings from AAPS several times and imported in NSClient. 
However, NSClient still refers to Virtual pump in hamburger/3lines menu (left), and has a constant 75U in the remaining amount in reservoir field. 
This means I can't reliably see if the reservoir is getting low, which is a function I previously used a lot.

The other issue is also visible in the screenshot below. Occasionally when receiving a new glucose value in NSClient, it won't render the corresponding "dot" in the graph, even though it can display the glucose value. When the next glucose value is received at the next 5 minute interval, it backfills the previous dot as well. So this is a very minor annoyance, but wanted to mention it as well. 
![Screenshot_20211025-095631_NSClient](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/71758682/138659847-a6d1f0c3-767b-4e1d-b988-14ea33c00126.jpg)
![Screenshot_20211025-090751_NSClient](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/71758682/138659851-b07cc454-3e8b-4520-a02d-c038f7c5ee25.jpg)
